findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "edit_pdf" is 993 chars, far longer than this server's median (161). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: edit_pdf · Private data: unlock_pdf · Public sink: redact_pdf, find_personal_data · Destructive: delete_pages, image_to_text.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: edit_pdf · Private data: unlock_pdf · Public sink: redact_pdf, find_personal_data · Destructive: delete_pages, image_to_text

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "pdf_to_word" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet:
before: "Конвертирует PDF в редактируемый Word-документ (.docx).
file_url: публичный URL PDF-файла." → after: "Конвертирует PDF в редактируемый Word-документ (.docx).

ocr: скан без текста — распознать текст (русский и английский); до 100 страниц, цена — как у ocr_pdf."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
